title: the fields every record starts with; a kind's schema refers to them as base.schema.json#/$defs/<name>

at.description: when the record was first written, ISO 8601 in UTC with Z; it never changes

by.description: who wrote it: an agent's name, or user for what a page sends for the user; it never changes

id.description: for a kind that other records point to; a kind's own schema gives its form, such as ^T\d+$
